strings.zh: 我们是喜欢帮助{NEWLINE}旅行中的训练家的一家人。{CLEAR}你如果能答对我的问题,{CLEAR}我会送你道具哦。{CLEAR}要尝试一下回答问题吗？
strings.en: We’re a family who loves helping{NEWLINE}Trainers on their travels.{SCROLL}If you can answer my questions{NEWLINE}correctly, I’ll give you an item.{SCROLL}Want to try answering?
strings.notes: Quiz (#4–28): the intended answers aren't visible in the text (likely Flame Orb / Focus Sash / Light Clay / Focus Sash / Soothe Bell).

strings.zh: 拥有毅力特性的精灵,{NEWLINE}携带下列哪个道具伤害加成最高？
strings.en: For a Pokémon with the Guts Ability,{NEWLINE}which of these held items gives the{CLEAR}biggest damage boost?

strings.en: Which of these items is single-use?

strings.en: You got some of the questions wrong.

strings.zh: 看来你对道具的事情真的很了解,{NEWLINE}那我就把这个这个送给你吧。{CLEAR}以你的见识应该能发挥出它的威力。
strings.en: You really know your items! Then I’ll{NEWLINE}give you this.{SCROLL}Someone as knowledgeable as you should{NEWLINE}be able to bring out its full power.

strings.zh: 我的孩子们在城都各地{NEWLINE}为旅行中的训练家提供有帮助的道具。{CLEAR}你在旅行中或许会遇到他们哦。
strings.en: My children are all over Johto, giving{NEWLINE}Trainers on their travels useful items.{SCROLL}You might run into them on your{NEWLINE}journey.
